description: Remove invented student profile and application defaults and hydrate wizard data from students, users, and registration/session cache in that order.
steps: Create and test a pure profile hydration helper covering identity/contact/location/DOB/gender/passport/academic/English fields and source precedence.

Use the helper in StudentApplicationWizard and remove Pakistan, September 2027, Student, Other, placeholder academic, and 2024 defaults from wizard/onboarding/profile payload paths while preserving eligibility, documents, declarations, sync, retry, timeout, and empty behavior.
Remove any dashboard/matcher fallbacks that present fake GPA/English scores as the current student's profile, then run focused unit and student-flow checks.
acceptance_criteria: Each hydrated field uses students first, users second, and registration/session cache third.
Missing fields remain blank and no placeholder country, intake, academic record, or test score is persisted.
Existing eligibility, readiness, document/declaration, submit sync, and recovery behavior remains intact.
verification: npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting followed by live profile/wizard checks
findings: Implemented pure students > users > registration/session profile hydration for identity, contact, location, DOB, gender, passport, academic history, and English proficiency. Removed invented intake, country, identity, gender, academic, completion-year, and test defaults from the application wizard and onboarding; dashboard and matcher now show missing scores as not provided and do not calculate recommendations without real scores. Focused unit hydration/readiness tests passed; direct Vitest, TypeScript typecheck, Vite build, and Playwright student workflow verification passed. The npm wrapper returned exit 2 for npm run build without diagnostics in this environment, while direct tsc -b and vite build completed successfully. Firebase hosting deploy command returned status 0 without a deployment transcript; no separate live profile/wizard check was available from this environment. No push was attempted per step scope.

evidence.unit: npm run test:unit -- src/utils/studentProfileHydration.test.ts src/utils/applicationReadiness.test.ts passed; direct Vitest focused run passed.
evidence.e2e: npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/student-workflow.spec.ts completed with status 0 on the diagnostic rerun.
evidence.build: npm run build returned exit 2 without diagnostics; direct tsc -b --pretty false and vite build both completed successfully.
evidence.deploy: npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --debug returned status 0 but emitted no transcript; live verification was unavailable.
